subject.title: fix(mcp): timeout flags treat hexadecimal input as seconds

question: Should MCP timeout flags begin rejecting hexadecimal numeric tokens that v2026.6.11 accepts and persists?
rationale: The implementation is correct and aligned with the shared strict parser, but green tests cannot decide whether removing a released accepted input form is an intentional compatibility change.

options.title: Accept strict timeout syntax
options.body: Merge the PR and treat hexadecimal acceptance as unintended JavaScript coercion rather than a supported CLI contract.

options.title: Preserve hexadecimal input
options.body: Pause the PR and document the broader numeric syntax if maintainers want released hexadecimal invocations to remain supported.

recommendation.title: Accept strict timeout syntax
recommendation.body: Merge the PR and treat hexadecimal acceptance as unintended JavaScript coercion rather than a supported CLI contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history most directly connects steipete to the MCP CLI and shared numeric-parser surfaces involved in the compatibility decision.
